arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Redding argued the Federal Circuit was wrong.
He claimed district court jurisdiction existed before new laws.
Mr. Marcus argued the Tax Court has exclusive power.
He cited the structure of the interest abatement statute.
